coordinates: pixel centers x+0.5,y+0.5; lower-left; half-open ROI
sampling: Target alpha at (x,y) = approved alpha at (x-d,y), horizontal linear interpolation (bilinear with unchanged y); no intensity renormalization, clipping or Jacobian scaling.
frame16: frames16..24 copy approved exactly via zero displacement; frame40 equals T02 target exactly
seam_caveat: No upper-y taper. At ROI top y=55 target is abruptly replaced by approved; outside equality does not prove seam continuity.
amplitude_is_not: a measured centroid threshold, physical force, historical R22 pass criterion, or adjustable search parameter
